en: A blue whale's tongue weighs about 2,700 kilograms, which is roughly the same weight as a small car.
Some species of bamboo can grow up to 91 centimeters in a single day, making it the fastest-growing plant on Earth.
A single drop of human blood contains approximately five million red blood cells, which carry oxygen throughout the entire body.
A peregrine falcon can reach diving speeds of over 389 kilometers per hour, making it the fastest animal on the planet.
The Great Barrier Reef stretches for over 2,300 kilometers and is composed of roughly 2,900 individual reef systems.
A single seed capsule of a tropical orchid can contain up to three million tiny, dust-like seeds.
If you laid out all the blood vessels in an average adult human body end-to-end, they would stretch about 160,000 kilometers.
A giraffe has exactly seven neck vertebrae, which is the exact same number of neck bones found in a human.
Periodical cicadas spend either 13 or 17 years underground as nymphs before emerging as adults to mate and lay eggs.
A human baby is born with about 270 bones, but many fuse together, leaving an adult with only 206 bones.
While an elephant's heart beats only 30 times per minute, a tiny pygmy shrew's heart beats an astonishing 1,200 times per minute.
A single large oak tree can transpire and release nearly 150,000 liters of water vapor into the atmosphere every year.
